title: Unified observability IaC module for VPC: OTLP collector, metrics, and log shippers
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Provide a single opinionated Terraform module that installs and manages the observability stack inside customer VPCs for Redwood Private deployments. The module should deploy Prometheus (metrics), Grafana (dashboards), an OpenTelemetry Collector (OTel) for metrics/traces, and a log-shipping agent (Fluent Bit) to configurable destinations. It must support seamless upgrades, health checks, lifecycle hooks, and low-risk rollout patterns for production customers.

Scope:
- Terraform module with clear inputs/outputs and composable submodules for prometheus, grafana, otel-collector, and fluent-bit/logship.
- Health-check resources and a reconciler-friendly lifecycle to enable safe canary/upgrades.
- Integration with existing VPC networking, IAM/KMS for secrets, S3-compatible or cloud object storage for logs, and optional remote_write for Prometheus.
- Docs, acceptance tests, and a migration path for customers currently using older telemetry modules.

Non-goals: Full multi-tenant Grafana hosting or creating new long-term retention storage. This module will integrate with Redwood-approved remote storage backends only.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes a single root terraform module that can be applied in a customer VPC and deploy prometheus, grafana, otel-collector, and fluent-bit with sane defaults
Upgrades support: canary rollout strategy and automatic rollback on failing health checks
Health check endpoints: prometheus readiness, otel collector ingest latency, fluent-bit log forwarder queue depth monitored via k8s readiness probes or terraform null_resource health checks
Automated tests: terraform plan/apply integration in CI with mocked cloud backends and a smoke test to verify metrics/logs pipeline end-to-end
Docs: migration guide for previous telemetry modules and a configuration reference with all inputs/outputs
migration_plan: 1) Create compatibility shim variables for customers using old module names. 2) Provide a migration terraform script that imports existing resources where possible. 3) Run a staged rollout: internal sandbox -> select dedicated customers (1-2) -> general availability. 4) Provide runbook for manual rollback and data retention considerations.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: Upgrading collector image could break parsing/transforms. Mitigation: pin collector versions in module and add an optional transform compatibility layer; run canary with subset of traffic.
Risk: Terraform state drift when switching modules. Mitigation: provide import helper script and clear mapping for resource addresses
Risk: Secrets exposure during upgrade. Mitigation: require KMS/HSM-backed secret references and never inline credentials in TF state outputs
implementation_notes: Design favors a composed module: root module delegates to submodules (prometheus/, grafana/, otel/, logship/) so customers can opt-out of pieces. Use provider meta-arguments to allow AWS/GCP/Azure variants. Use terraform >=1.5 and adopt the modular testing harness (terratest + localstack/minio for CI).
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff meeting with Infra and Security. Decided to require KMS for secrets and support S3-compatible endpoints for log sink.
2026-03-05: Prototype submodule layout sketched; prometheus remote_write and grafana datasource automation considered.
2026-03-08: Submodule for otel-collector implemented in k8s helm chart form; need to add lifecycle preStop hooks for cache flush before pod deletion.
2026-03-11: Integration test pipeline added to CI (terratest + minio + vectordemo). CI currently green for basic deploy; failing on prometheus retention mount tests.
2026-03-13: Security review scheduled; documented KMS key rotation procedure and reduced S3 object ACL exposure
todos: Add canary selector and automated rollback trigger (scripted via terraform null_resource and API checks)
Finalize prometheus retention and PVC strategy for on-cluster vs remote storage
Add grafana provisioning via API and seed dashboards for Redwood standard observability views
Add terraform import helpers and update migration docs
notes_for_reviewers: Look for: 1) clear upgrade/rollback semantics, 2) security of secret handling and KMS integration, 3) minimal blast radius defaults for non-production customers. Please comment on the proposed canary gating metrics (collector ingestion latency, fluent-bit queue growth, prometheus scrape success rate).
estimated_cost_impact: Medium: reduces unit cost by consolidating remote_write and retention, but initial support and testing add engineering cost.
customer-facing_message: This module improves reliability and observability in Private deployments by providing a tested, upgradeable observability stack. Customers will be able to opt into the new module via the migration script; we will coordinate upgrades with customer success for GA rollouts.
